data_collected: sessions, time in the app and notification taps
a push token, device model and carrier

trackers.monetization_model: OneSignal sells messaging (push, in-app, email and SMS) to app developers, with a free plan, and processes app users' data on their behalf; it says it doesn't sell personal information.

data_flows.purpose: Your sessions, time in the app, notification taps and in-app purchases, for the developer's messages and analytics; OneSignal says it may also predict your interests for the developer
data_flows.wording: According to OneSignal's SDK documentation (read 2026-10-08) and its privacy policy (last updated 2024-04-12).

confidence_note.text: OneSignal's Google Play guidance (read 2026-10-08) tells developers it doesn't collect approximate location or device IDs by default. Its privacy policy (last updated 2024-04-12) lists location inferred from IP address and mobile device identifiers among what its mobile SDKs collect, and its SDK data page lists country, IP address and push tokens. This record follows the policy and the SDK data page.
